description: In repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts, make the honest refusal a distinct persisted outcome: at the site where the deterministic reach verdict is returned with reason starting "deterministic:no-oracle-for-goal-class", carry a machine-readable declined marker through to the persisted trace — alongside the existing reached:false tag, persist an additional tag "outcome:declined" (and when verifierFamilyOf identifies the family, also "declined_family:<family>") via the same reach-patch path that persists the reached:* tags. Do not change posterior behavior: beta stays withheld exactly as today; the change is only that a refusal becomes queryable in the trace store as a refusal instead of being indistinguishable from a failed attempt. Success is checkable: after a countable goal with no deterministic verifier runs, its execution trace row carries the tag outcome:declined.
